title: Each Coffee Makes Me TWICE As Fast ☕
premise: At my office every coffee makes you twice as fast and the speed never wears off. Most people stop at two. On a Friday with a report due I drink nine, while my best friend Kai, who sits one desk over, has been too busy for me all year.
twist: At nine cups I am fast enough to see the people who drank a tenth: frozen cyan streaks doing the whole office's work. Kai is one of them, finishing my work for a year. The rule never says what decaf does, so ten decafs bring him back down to normal speed, but they were every decaf in the building and I am stuck at nine.
world: one bright open-plan office on a high floor with cream desks, espresso chairs, big windows, plants and a shiny coffee machine with a coffee spout and a decaf spout
